## Key facts

- Fifteen years from hotel revenue analysis to payments-scale reliability engineering.
- Designed and built OIP, an Operational Intelligence Platform: alert ingestion, incident correlation, governed AI triage with local and hosted models, reproducible scorecards, and a supervisor that gates every autonomous write.
- Builds by designing systems and directing AI coding agents under governance (evals, approvals, one writer per repo), then reviewing the output.
